worldcombat.skill.megadrain.summary: Hurl a glowing pod from a distance; on impact it drains the target over several waves, returning a share of the damage actually dealt as health. The burst form hits heavier in a single wave; the latching form spreads the drain over several waves for more total damage and healing.
The bursting pod deals about %1$s special damage; the target's defence, type and crits are applied on the hit.
On impact it drains in %1$s waves in all (the first wave is the pod's burst), one every %2$s s; the follow-up waves stay on the same target and stop if it falls or leaves.
The pod flies along your aim about %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick; it only bursts on a target and fizzles out if it reaches its limit without hitting.
Each wave returns %1$s of the damage it actually dealt to the user as health.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.burst.on: Burst pod: one heavier burst, but only a single wave, less healing and a slower rhythm.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.burst.off: Latching pod: several waves that add up to more damage and healing, but each is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.growth.0: From level %1$s the pod power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.growth.1: From level %1$s the pod power rises to %2$s, the drain share to %3$s and the waves to %4$s.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.0: Hurl a pod that strikes a foe from a distance
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.1: Trade several waves of damage and healing at once
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.use.2: Sustain against a target that will not let you close in
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.preference.b: On: one heavier burst, but a single wave, less healing and a slower rhythm - good for one decisive hit or a finish. Off: the latching pod - several waves with more total damage and healing, better for sustain.
worldcombat.skill.megadrain.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in rather than throwing. Larger opens with a pod from further away.
Below this health ratio the user prefers mega drain as sustain; higher starts leaning on it for healing sooner.
